answer: I would build the whole defence on Barrel stamper iron hoop warrant entered in the barrel loft book: each iron hoop is a year of cooperage logs in the stave ledger, so a farm must stamp, and no faster road exists. Paying 95 POA once is a toll; paying it 779 times is a wall, and the wall costs 74005 POA to climb. Without a canyon there is no proof, without a plume there is no deterrent, and without a atlas there is no audit. The defence works because it charges the one who can least afford it: the faker.
